bhattasammada.p: [Bhatta+sammada] (pu) Google Translate Eating and drinking Dizziness due to rice. Dizziness, burning, and fatigue caused by eating rice.
a: ဘတ္တသမ္မဒ(ပု)
ထမင်းယစ်ခြင်း၊ ထမင်းကြောင့်ဖြစ်သော-တွေဝေ-ပူလောင်-ပင်ပန်း-ခြင်း၊ ထမင်း-ဆွမ်း-စားခြင်းကြောင့်ဖြစ်သော-တွေဝေ-ပူလောင်-ပင်ပန်း-ခြင်း။

bhattasammada：ဘတ္တ-သမ္မဒ （ပ）
ထမင်းဆီယစ်ခြင်း။ ဆွမ်းဆီယစ်ခြင်း။
DOP: bhatta mfn., m. and n. [ pp of bhajati qv; S. bhakta], 1. ( mfn., m. ) serving; attached to; a devotee, follower; Vin III 265, 11 (bahū āvuso saṅghassa dāyakā bahū saṅghassa ~ā; cf Sp 732, 19 foll.: ~ā ti saṅghassa bahūni ~āni anekāni lābhamukhāni, na saṅghassa kenaci parihānī ti dīpenti, Be, Se so; Ce bhaddā ti … bahūni bhadrāni …; Ee bhadrā ti … bahūni bhadrāni); Sv 546, 16 (sambhattā ti suṭṭhu ~ā sinehavanto daḷhamittā); It-a I 10, 1 (kathaṃ bhattavā ti bhagavā, ~ā daḷhabhattikā assa bahū atthī ti bhattavā); — ifc see brahma- ( sv brahma[n] ), brāhmaṇa-; — 2. ( n. ) food (esp. boiled rice); a meal; Abh 465 (odano vā kuraṃ ~aṃ); Vin I 26, 9 (kālo mahāsamaṇa niṭṭhitaṃ ~aṃ); 212, 36 (adhivāsetu me bhante bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya ~aṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā ti); 220, 24 (yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāmā tadā ~aṃ karissāmā ti); III 13, 18 foll. (Sudinno Kalandakaputto ekaṃ pi ~aṃ na bhuñji dve pi ~āni … satta pi ~ani na bhuñji); IV 37, 34 (Dabbo Mallaputto saṅghassa senāsanaṃ ca paññāpeti ~āni ca uddisati); 72, 1 (manussā gilāne bhikkhū ~ena nimantenti); 129, 25 ([dārakā] rodanti yāguṃ detha ~aṃ detha khādaniyaṃ dethā ti); D I 72, 6 (~aṃ c’ assa na chādeyya); II 128, 6* (Cundassa ~aṃ bhuñjitvā kammārassā ti me sutaṃ ābādhaṃ samphusī dhīro); M II 139, 14 foll. (so bhuttāvī anumodati na taṃ ~aṃ garahati na aññaṃ ~aṃ paṭikaṅkhati); A III 57, 26 (n’ eva nhāyati na vilimpati na ~aṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti); Dhp 185 (mattaññutā ca ~asmiṃ); Vv 22:5 (acchādanaṃ ca ~aṃ ca senāsanaṃ padīpiyaṃ adāsiṃ); Pv 26:6 (petā ~āya gacchanti); 29:5 (tassa kammassa vipākena … sugandhasālino ~aṃ gūthaṃ me parivattati); Th 248 (paccati munino ~aṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule); Thī 32 (ekena ~ena muṇḍā); Ja II 227, 22 (macchesu sannipatitesu ~aṃ dethā ti); 412, 12 (kukkuṭamaṃsaṃ ca ~aṃ ca sampādetvā); III 232, 5 (~aṃ bhinnaṃ; 232, 7´ : bhattapāti bhinnā); 327, 25* (rājā te ~aṃ pāhesi suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ); 383, 1 (ekadivasaṃ pacanto thokaṃ uttaṇḍulaṃ paci ekadivasaṃ thokaṃ kilinnaṃ … ekadivasaṃ aloṇaṃ ekadivasaṃ atiloṇaṃ); V 105, 1* (sā nūna … vikāle ~am āhari); 170, 4* (upanāmayī ~a manuññarūpaṃ, mc ); VI 366, 31 (te taṇḍule koṭṭetvā mūlataṇḍulehi yāguṃ majjhimataṇḍulehi ~aṃ kaṇikāhi pūvaṃ pacitvā); Mil 66, 13 (yadā tvaṃ bubhukkhito bhaveyyāsi tadā tvaṃ khettaṃ kasāpeyyāsi sāliṃ ropāpeyyāsi dhaññaṃ atiharāpeyyāsi ~aṃ bhuñjissāmī ti); Vism 383, 17 (bhariyāya nālikodanamattaṃ pi gahetvā sakalajambudīpavāsike parivisamānāya ~aṃ na khīyati); Sp 817, 24 (~aṃ ākiranti sūpavyañjanaṃ ākiranti); Sv 812, 21 (ayaṃ gūtho sūkarānaṃ ~aṃ); Spk I 161, 14 (suparisuddhehi sālitaṇḍulehi ~aṃ sampādetvā tadanurūpaṃ khādanīyaṃ vyañjanaṃ sūpeyyaṃ ca sallakkhetvā); Dhp-a I 436, 22 (etāsu ettikāsu cāṭīsu yāgu ettikāsu ~aṃ ettikāsu sappiphāṇitapūvādīni āsanāni paññattānī ti); III 332, 11 (so maṃsaṃ vinā ~aṃ na bhuñjati); Vv-a 24, 11 (nimantito vā ~ena atithi animantito abbhāgato); Pv-a 161, 21 (~aṃ ca vetanaṃ ca detha tumhākaṃ pi kammaṃ karomī ti, Be, Ce, Ee vatthaṃ ca veṭhanaṃ ca); Mhv 6:18 (~aṃ paṇṇesu dāpayi); — ifc see antara-, antarā- ( sv antarā 1 ), uddhaṭa- ( sv uddharati ), ussūra-, kutī̆-, guḷaka-, catukka- ( sv catukka 1 ), catuttha-, dvāra-, dhura-, dhuva-, nīhaṭa- ( sv nīharati ), nīhāra- ( sv nīhāra 1 ), pacchā- ( sv pacchā 2 ), pariyāya-, pārivāsika- ( sv pārivāsika 1 ), puṭa-, puṭaka-, pure-, bhāga-, mama-, sacīvara- ( sv cīvara ); — °’- agga , n. [bhatta + agga 2 ], a refectory; a dining-hall; Vin I 220, 32 (yannūnāhaṃ ~aṃ olokeyyaṃ yaṃ ~e nāssa taṃ paṭiyādeyyan ti); IV 76, 28 (so daliddo kammakāro ~e bhikkhū parivisati); M II 204, 24 (ekassa brāhmaṇassa evaṃ assa aho vata aham eva labheyyaṃ ~e aggāsanaṃ); Ja IV 144, 14 (rājā … paṇṇākāraṃ … ~aṃ pesetvā ~e bhikkhū natthī ti vutte …); V 334, 27 (sve vihāre ~aṃ bhavissatī ti); Spk I 228, 1 (brāhmaṇī … ~e brāhmaṇe parivisamānā); Ps I 145, 32 (~e ti bhojanaṭṭhāne); Dhp-a II 105, 11 (tassa ~e āsanapariyante āsanaṃ pāpuṇāti yāgubhattādīhi pi kilamati); III 382, 19 (te kira vihāre pi gāme pi ~aṃ ākulaṃ karontā vicaranti); Mhv 15:50; — ° âcchādaka , n. [ cf chādaka 2 ], the unpleasantness of the food; Vin I 200, 8 (iminā ca ~ena, Be, Se so; Ce °-cchādakena; Ee bhattācchandakena, prob. wr; Sp 1089, 26 : bhattaṃ arocikena, Be so; Ee, Se bhattassa anārocakena; Ce omits ); — ° âdaka , mfn. , eating food; A III 156, 19 (rañño nāgo ~o ca hoti; Mp III 286, 14 : °-kkhādako, bahubhattabhuñjo ti attho); — °’- addapuṭa - in Ee at Ja III 200, 14 is wr; read bhattapuṭa- with Be, Ce, Se; — ° âbhikaṅkhi(n) , mfn. , wishing for food; Mil 107, 3 ; — ° âbhihāra , m. , a bringing, an offering of food; Vin III 15, 21 (saṭṭhimatte thālipāke ~aṃ abhihariṃsu); D II 188, 11 (sāyapātaṃ ~o abhihariyittha; Sv 633, 1 : abhiharitabbabhattaṃ); 237, 32 (n’ amhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena ~enā ti); M II 126, 4 (rājānaṃ … ~e upasaṅkamitvā; Ps III 356, 15 : ~e ti bhattaṃ abhiharaṇaṭṭhāne); Ps IV 5, 20 (~aṃ olokento); Mhv 14:24; — °’- uddesaka , m. , one who assigns meals; Vin II 176, 6 (~ānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi kathaṃ nu kho bhattaṃ uddisitabbaṃ); III 159, 7 (sammato saṅghena āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto senāsanapaññāpako ca ~o ca); A II 19, 12 (Mp III 22, 21 : ~o ti salākabhattādīnaṃ uddesako); Vism 388, 7 ; Mp I 275, 10 (~-ttaṃ ca sampaṭicchi); — °’- uddesana , n. , assigning meals; Ap-a 505, 10 ; — °- kāra , m. , a cook; Abh 464; Sadd 383, 10 ; — °- kāraka , m. , °-kārikā, f. , a cook; Ja II 363, 3 (~o pi nānāmacchamaṃsavikatiyo sampādetvā sarīrato sedaṃ apanento mahānasadvāre aṭṭhāsi); III 445, 14 (°-kārikā); V 458, 18 (ṭhapitamaṃsaṃ ~assa pamādena rājagehe koleyyasunakhā khādiṃsu, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); Kv 599, 20 ; Ps II 391, 32 (°-kārikā dāsī); Spk III 201, 14 (sūdo ti ~o); — °- gāma , n. [bhatta + gāma 2 ], a tributary village; Dhp-a I 398, 11 (attano santakesu … cuddasasu ~esu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhutta-); — °- jīraṇaka , mfn. , aiding digestion of food; Sp 479, 9 (~-bhesajjaṃ); — °- paṭipāṭi , f. , a succession, a series, of meals; Vin IV 75, 28 ; — °- pācikā , ( m ) f ( n )., a woman who cooks food; Ps III 169, 8 ; — °- piṇḍa , m. , a lump or portion of food; Ja II 204, 10 (vatthakhaṇḍaṃ vā ~aṃ vā dātuṃ); III 412, 4 (ekaṃ pi ~aṃ labhitvā); V 228, 11 (mahantaṃ ~aṃ gahetvā); Dhp-a III 89, 9 (mayhaṃ etāya pātiyā ~e pipāsā jātā ti); — °- bhatika , m. , one who serves for food; Dhp-a III 90, 10 foll.; — °- randhaka , m. , °-randhikā, f. , a cook; one who cooks; Ja IV 431, 26 ; Sp 557, 10 (bhariyā jāyā … °-randhikā …); Kv-a 188, 10 (bhattakārakā ti hatthi-ādīnaṃ ~ā); — °- va(t) 2 , mfn. , who has devotees; It-a I 6, 13* (°-vā … bhagavā); 10, 1 (kathaṃ °-vā ti bhagavā, bhattā daḷhabhattikā assa bahū atthī ti bhagavā); — see also bhattava(t) 1 ( sv bhajati ); — °- vaḍḍhitaka , n. (?), a serving of food; Sv 562, 8 (mahagghaso puriso ekaṃ ~aṃ labhitvā aññaṃ pi hotu … kiṃ etaṃ mayhaṃ karissatī ti; Sv-pṭ II 206, 25 : bhuñjanabhājanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dinnaṃ bhattaṃ, ekāsane purisena bhuñjitabbabhattato upaḍḍhabhattan ti attho) = Ps III 258, 17 ( Be so; Ce, Ee °-vaḍḍhitikaṃ; Se ekabhattavaḍḍhitaṃ) = Mp IV 144, 22 = As 188, 22 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-vaḍḍhinikaṃ); Vv-a 293, 23 (ekāhaṃ bhikkhan ti … ekaṃ ~an ti attho); — °- vissagga , m. , the eating of food; a meal; Vin II 153, 6 (bhikkhū ajjhokāse ~aṃ karontā); IV 263, 13 (so bhikkhu tassā bhikkhuniyā santike ~aṃ karoti; Sp 922, 11 : ~an ti °-kiccaṃ); Pv 27:9 (ekajjhaṃ sannipatiṃsu ~-kāraṇā; Pv-a 184, 7 foll.: bhattakiccakāraṇā bhuñjananimittaṃ); Mil 9, 24 (theraṃ niccakālaṃ attano ghare ~-karaṇatthāya yāci); Mp I 163, 30 (yāgu-ādīni sampaṭicchanto ~aṃ akāsi); Mhv 4:27; — °- vetanabhata , °-vetanabhaṭa, m. , a servant paid with food and wages; Vism 348, 6 (~o antevāsiko, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se -bhaṭo) = Ps I 271, 18 ; Sp 996, 29 (yo koci rañño ~o, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se -bhaṭo); Ps III 8, 23 (kammakarā ti ~ā); Vv-a 305, 10 (duggatapuriso paresaṃ ~o hutvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee -bhaṭo); — °- sammada , m. , lethargy, drowsiness, after eating; D II 195, 33 ; S I 7, 8* (niddā tandī vijambhikā aratī ~o); Ja II 63, 14 ; Vibh 352, 16 (yā bhuttāvissa °-mucchā °-kilamatho °-pariḷāho kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ ayaṃ vuccati ~o); Vism 295, 8 (°-kiccaṃ katvā ~aṃ paṭivinodetvā); Dhp-a III 264, 16 (bhuttapātarāso ~aṃ avinodetvā … kilantarūpo); — °- hāraka , m. , °-hārikā, f. , (one) who carries food; a food-bearer; Ja II 434, 19 ; III 326, 12 (~aṃ alabhanto); V 105, 5´ (sā mama °-hārikā itthi); Pj II 72, 26 (rañño ~ehi saddhiṃ pavisitvā); — °- hārī , f. , one who carries food; a food-bearer; Ja V 105, 2* (~iṃ avekkhanto); — sabhatta , mfn. , with a meal; Vin IV 98, 25 (yo pana bhikkhu nimantito ~o samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya pācittiyan ti; 100, 17 : ~o nāma yena nimantito tena ~o); Bv 11:11 (saṅghaṃ ~aṃ dussaṃ adās’ ahaṃ; Bv-a 194, 24 : sacīvaraṃ bhattaṃ adāsiṃ); Utt-vn 108; — see also antobhattika ( sv anto ), ekabhattika ( sv eka ), kalyāṇabhattika ( sv kalyāṇa ), khalupacchābhatti(n), khalupacchābhattika ( sv khalu 1 ), dhuvabhattika ( sv dhuva ), niccabhattika ( sv nicca ), pacchābhattika ( sv pacchā 2 ), pariyāyabhattika ( sv pariyāya ), bahibhattika ( sv bahi ).
